parts.text:
This assignment seems to have something to do with Vesna. You and Paimon both suspect it might be a prank...

#### Go to the Zapolyarny Palace

**Paimon:** Your Majesty, we're here...

**Vesna:** Take this!

**Paimon:** Ehhh!?

**Anastasya:** ...Vesna. Is this the "friendly spar" you requested in your report?

**Vesna:** Uh... Your Majesty! I assure you, that was an honorable, fair and square, head-on clash! ...Er, maybe with a dash of underhandedness for seasoning!

**Anastasya:** Drawing your blade in here is a breach of decorum. You will report to Countess Shakhovskaya for punishment afterward. Now, do you still question Traveler's strength?

**Vesna:** Not at all! If anything, I'd already witnessed that strength firsthand. I just... really wanted to experience it for myself, too...

**Vesna:** Hehe, but I guess anyone who can go toe-to-toe with Danica is bound to be something special.

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** What's going on?

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** So, what's this all about?

##### Shared continuation

**Vesna:** Okay, long story short: Her Majesty wants Traveler to inspect the Druzhna!

**Paimon:** Wait, what? U—Us? That's a bit sudden! And how would we even go about it...

**Anastasya:** Vesna, proceed.

**Vesna:** Yes, Your Majesty! Now then, Traveler, Paimon. Know that the glorious Druzhna have a proud history stretching all the way back to the days of Grand Duke Filipov—

**Anastasya:** ...The history lesson can wait, Vesna.

**Vesna:** Yes, Your Majesty! In short, the Druzhna have always shouldered countless vital responsibilities. Whether slaying monsters or upholding Her Majesty's honor, we are duty-bound to see it done!

**Vesna:** Her Majesty also inspects us regularly to ensure we remain worthy of these responsibilities.

**Paimon:** Whoa, Vesna can actually get serious? That's not something you see every day...

**Vesna:** And today, we are due for another inspection! By Her Majesty's command, you will conduct it in her stead, Traveler!

- **Traveler:** Me? How?

**Vesna:** Through combat, of course! Nothing reveals a soldier's character better than battle!

**Paimon:** So you're saying Traveler has to fight the Druzhna?

**Vesna:** We are Her Majesty's personal guard, her sword, honed by rime and the raw, rending winds.

**Vesna:** You're a swordmaster yourself, Traveler. You know the best way to judge a blade isn't to stand back and look at it.

**Vesna:** Ahem! So! I, Vesna Strivozha, by Her Majesty's decree, shall lead the Druzhna into battle against you!

**Paimon:** Wait, wait, wait! You aren't just gonna show up with the whole force and bum-rush Traveler or something, are you?

**Vesna:** Of course not! We're the glorious Druzhna. We would never pile in all at once. But since you're so strong, Traveler...

**Vesna:** ...Hehe, how about helping me test out some new tactics while we're at it?

- **Traveler:** What sort of new tactics are we talking about here?

**Vesna:** Ah, ah, ah, that's classified! They're "new" tactics, remember? Telling you would spoil the surprise.

**Vesna:** ...Er! A—Anyway, that's all!

**Anastasya:** It is as Vesna says. I invited you here, Traveler, in the hope that you might offer some guidance to the Druzhna in your capacity as Privy Councilor.

- **Traveler:** Got it.

**Anastasya:** Mm. I have heard much of your swordsmanship and valor. You need not hold back. Simply do your best.

**Anastasya:** That is all. Vesna, go now, and take Traveler with you.

**Vesna:** Yes! Your Majesty!

#### Go to Druzhna HQ

**Vesna:** Traveler, you're up next! Oh, and by the way, Yarovaya and the others are still pretty nervous.

- **Traveler:** Why would they be?

**Vesna:** *sigh*... Oh, come on, think about everything you've done! You've got quite the reputation in Snezhnaya, you know?

**Vesna:** Oh, right. During past inspections, the Druzhna fought mock enemies under Her Majesty's command. This time, she wants Yarovaya to take command.

**Vesna:** Of course, the glorious Druzhna won't fall apart just because Her Majesty isn't giving the orders. But since you're our opponent, it will be quite the challenge...

**Vesna:** I mean, one Druzhna soldier on their own? You'd send them flying with a quick one-two. And if that happens, then Her Majesty wouldn't get to see the results of our training...

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** What are you playing at?

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** So what exactly are these "new tactics"!?

##### Shared continuation

**Paimon:** Hey, Vesna! You promised earlier you weren't gonna have a whole bunch of people gang up on us! No takesie-backsies!

**Vesna:** Hehehe, relax, relax! I know what I'm doing. I'm not gonna make things hard for Traveler.

**Paimon:** There's something off about how you said that. Paimon's got her eye on you, lady...

**Vesna:** Your Majesty! We are ready, and so is Traveler!

**Anastasya:** Then proceed as usual.

**Vesna:** Yes! Your Majesty!

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** Either way, bring it on.

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** I can handle anything.

##### Shared continuation

**Vesna:** That's the spirit! Not bad, not bad. We'll give it everything we've got, too!

**Vesna:** Glorious Druzhna! For Her Majesty's honor, let's give them a fair and square, head-on clash topped with a dash of underhandedness!

#### Spar with the Druzhna

#### Report the results of the inspection

**Anastasya:** Halt.

**Yarovaya:** Uh...! Yes, Your Majesty!

**Paimon:** Traveler, are you okay? ...Whoa, you're drenched in sweat! Quick, have some water!

- **Traveler:** (...Near-flawless discipline. The moment one fell back, another stepped in. Not a trace of disorder, whether attacking or defending.)

- **Traveler:** (And... they were deliberately keeping their last card in reserve. So that's what Vesna meant by new tactics...)

- **Traveler:** (Vesna stayed out of the fight, too. I see... Was that the plan? Do everything they could to wear me down, then have her fight me one-on-one...?)

**Anastasya:** Vesna. Was it you who ordered them to hold back?

**Vesna:** Yes, Your Majesty! It was a battle, but not to the death. The scars the Druzhna wear with pride should be earned against our true foes!

**Vesna:** Still, rest assured that apart from those few tactics that would have risked lives, we used everything we had!

**Vesna:** Such is the might of the one you personally elevated to Privy Councilor, Your Majesty!

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** Vesna...

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** I thought we agreed you wouldn't all attack at once...

##### Shared continuation

**Vesna:** Well, about that... um... Ahaha, everyone just really wanted a crack at the big celebrity! Can't blame them, right? This way, everybody got their wish!

**Vesna:** Besides, as Privy Councilor, you'll have the authority to mobilize the Druzhna directly under special circumstances.

**Vesna:** And what better way to get to know a commander than to cross swords with them for real?

- **Traveler:** Are all Snezhnayans like this?

**Vesna:** Well, everyone in the Druzhna is, at least... What's wrong? What are you looking at me for?

**Anastasya:** Vesna.

**Vesna:** Yes, Your Majesty! I am fully satisfied that Traveler can lead the Druzhna in an emergency and ensure they continue to fulfill their duties!

- **Traveler:** Wait, what exactly counts as an emergency...?

**Vesna:** Hehe, that would be the scenario where we have already laid down our lives for Her Majesty but she still requires any remaining Druzhna to execute their duties.

**Vesna:** When that time comes, Traveler, you'll be the Commander of the Druzhna.

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** Knock on wood!

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** What are you talking about? You're the Commander, Vesna.

##### Shared continuation

**Vesna:** Oh, don't make that face. Snezhnaya's glory is forged through sacrifice. Our duty to defend our homeland is more than mere words.

**Vesna:** For Her Majesty's glory and the people of Snezhnaya, we must carry out our duties faithfully. Whose life that costs has never been the point.

**Anastasya:** Do not dwell on it too much, Traveler. Vesna only speaks of a contingency plan to be used in extremis.

**Anastasya:** Nonetheless, I believe you have the ability to fulfill this role, and the courage to shoulder this responsibility.

- **Traveler:** Got it.

**Anastasya:** Vesna. A fine exercise today. New formation?

**Vesna:** Yes, Your Majesty! After you gave us those new requirements last time, I developed these tactics to meet them!

**Vesna:** With this approach, the Druzhna alone can tie up a single powerful enemy for a good long time. Then I go in for the decapitation strike!

**Anastasya:** Hmm. Well done, Vesna. You are indeed a worthy successor to the command of the Druzhna.

**Anastasya:** These tactics have proved effective in combat. The Druzhna shall be duly rewarded.

**Vesna:** Our thanks, Your Majesty! The Druzhna will train harder and reach new heights! And I... will go to Countess Shakhovskaya and learn some etiquette!

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** Very interesting tactics.

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** But not enough to stop me.

##### Shared continuation

**Vesna:** That's for sure! You've certainly got what it takes to be Privy Councilor. If we work together in the future, I'll know I can count on you.

**Paimon:** Hey, Vesna! You're playing dumb again! Those tactics were totally designed to take on Traveler!

**Paimon:** No, wait! You brought Traveler here just so you could train your troops, didn't you?

**Vesna:** No, no! Her Majesty really did order me to test your strength as Privy Councilor. I just thought I'd give you a little surprise while I was at it.

- **Traveler:** Ves...na...

**Anastasya:** ...

**Anastasya:** Vesna, you are to arrange the upcoming independent training exercises.

**Anastasya:** Traveler, as their reserve Commander, you will accompany them in that training.

**Vesna:** Yes, Your Majesty! Leave it to the two of us!

**Anastasya:** Good. Report back to the palace if there are new developments.

**Vesna:** Hehehe, so, Traveler, tea? I swiped this from Danica's stash. Trust me, it's the good stuff...

- **Traveler:** I challenge you to a duel, Commander Vesna.

**Vesna:** Hahaha, oh, no need for that! I mean, we just finished training, we're all dead tired. C'mon, tea, tea! Look at you...

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** You didn't even take the field earlier.

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** Take the field. I want to duel you one-on-one.

##### Shared continuation

**Vesna:** Oh dear! I almost forgot I have all these important matters to report to Her Majesty. So sorry, but I've got to go. See you next time, Traveler—

**Paimon:** Hold it! No flying off, Vesna! Vesna! Hey! How are you that fast!?

**Yarovaya:** The Commander sure is a fast flier...
